meanings.tr: her işi bilen (ama hiçbirinde usta olmayan) kişi, elinden her iş gelen
meanings.en: a person who can do many different types of work but is not an expert in any of them
meanings.exampleEn: He's a jack-of-all-trades who can fix the car, wire a plug and lay bricks.
meanings.exampleTr: O, arabayı tamir edebilen, fiş bağlayabilen ve tuğla örebilen, elinden her iş gelen biri.

meanings.en: a person whose job is to look after a building, such as a school or a block of flats
meanings.exampleEn: The janitor unlocked the classroom and turned on the lights.
meanings.exampleTr: Hademe sınıfın kilidini açtı ve ışıkları yaktı.

meanings.en: a light spear thrown as a sport, or the event of throwing it
meanings.exampleEn: She threw the javelin more than sixty metres to win the gold medal.
meanings.exampleTr: Altın madalyayı kazanmak için ciriti altmış metreden fazla attı.

meanings.en: something said or done to be funny; a joke
meanings.exampleEn: He made a jest about the terrible weather to lighten the mood.
meanings.exampleTr: Havayı yumuşatmak için berbat hava hakkında bir şaka yaptı.

meanings.en: to say something in order to be funny; to joke
meanings.exampleEn: "Surely you jest!" she said with a laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: "Şaka yapıyorsun herhalde!" dedi gülerek.

meanings.en: a wooden or stone structure built out into water where boats can be tied
meanings.exampleEn: We tied the boat to the jetty and stepped ashore.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekneyi iskeleye bağladık ve karaya çıktık.

meanings.en: a person who makes, repairs or sells jewellery and watches
meanings.exampleEn: The jeweller resized my ring while I waited.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuyumcu ben beklerken yüzüğümün ölçüsünü ayarladı.

meanings.en: extreme and aggressive patriotism, often involving a hostile attitude to other countries
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper's coverage of the war was criticised for its blatant jingoism.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazetenin savaş haberleri, apaçık şovenizmi nedeniyle eleştirildi.

meanings.en: believing in or showing extreme, aggressive patriotism
meanings.exampleEn: The politician gave a jingoistic speech calling for war against the neighbouring country.
meanings.exampleTr: Politikacı, komşu ülkeye karşı savaş çağrısı yapan şovenist bir konuşma yaptı.

meanings.en: to work together in order to achieve a shared aim
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies joined forces to develop a new type of engine.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirket, yeni tip bir motor geliştirmek için güçlerini birleştirdi.

meanings.en: a person who makes the wooden parts of a building, such as doors and window frames
meanings.exampleEn: We hired a joiner to build fitted wardrobes in the bedroom.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatak odasına gömme dolaplar yapması için bir doğramacı tuttuk.

meanings.en: the state of being happy and full of fun; cheerful celebration
meanings.exampleEn: The festival was full of music, dancing and general jollity.
meanings.exampleTr: Festival müzik, dans ve genel bir neşeyle doluydu.

meanings.en: to push roughly against people in a crowd
meanings.exampleEn: Shoppers jostled each other to reach the discounted goods.
meanings.exampleTr: Alışverişçiler indirimli mallara ulaşmak için birbirlerini itip kaktı.

meanings.en: short notes written down quickly
meanings.exampleEn: Her notebook was full of jottings and half-finished ideas.
meanings.exampleTr: Defteri kısa notlar ve yarım kalmış fikirlerle doluydu.

meanings.en: cheerful and friendly
meanings.exampleEn: Our host was a jovial man who kept everyone laughing.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev sahibimiz herkesi güldüren neşeli bir adamdı.

meanings.en: a feeling of great happiness, usually because of a success
meanings.exampleEn: There were scenes of jubilation in the streets when the team won the cup.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım kupayı kazanınca sokaklarda coşku sahneleri yaşandı.

meanings.en: mixed up in a confused and untidy way
meanings.exampleEn: The letters were jumbled up and I couldn't read the word.
meanings.exampleTr: Harfler karmakarışıktı ve kelimeyi okuyamadım.

meanings.tr: geri durmak, uzak tutmak; saklamak, esirgemek
meanings.en: to stay away from something, or to prevent someone/something from moving forward or being revealed
meanings.exampleEn: The police told the crowd to keep back from the edge of the platform.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis kalabalığa peron kenarından geri durmasını söyledi.

meanings.en: to not tell someone all that you know
meanings.exampleEn: I felt he was keeping something back from me.
meanings.exampleTr: Benden bir şeyler sakladığını hissettim.

meanings.en: to remain calm and not become angry or upset
meanings.exampleEn: Try to keep cool when you're dealing with an angry customer.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli bir müşteriyle uğraşırken sakin kalmaya çalış.

meanings.en: to move or make progress at the same rate as someone or something else
meanings.exampleEn: She walked so fast that I could hardly keep up with her.
meanings.exampleTr: O kadar hızlı yürüdü ki ona ayak uydurmakta zorlandım.

meanings.en: to continue something at the same level
meanings.exampleEn: Keep up the good work!
meanings.exampleTr: İyi çalışmayı sürdür!

meanings.en: a person who takes someone away illegally, usually to demand money for their return
meanings.exampleEn: The kidnappers demanded a ransom of one million dollars.
meanings.exampleTr: Adam kaçıranlar bir milyon dolarlık fidye talep etti.

meanings.en: your family and relatives
meanings.exampleEn: When she died, the police tried to trace her next of kin.
meanings.exampleTr: O öldüğünde polis en yakın akrabasını bulmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: hit by a vehicle and made to fall to the ground
meanings.exampleEn: An elderly man was knocked down by a car while crossing the road.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı bir adam yolu geçerken bir arabanın çarpmasıyla yere düştü.

meanings.en: demolished; made to fall to the ground by force
meanings.exampleEn: The old warehouse was knocked down to make way for flats.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski depo, apartmanlara yer açmak için yıkıldı.

meanings.en: practical knowledge and skill in how to do something
meanings.exampleEn: The company has the technical know-how to build electric cars.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, elektrikli araba üretecek teknik uzmanlığa sahip.

meanings.en: needing a lot of time and effort
meanings.exampleEn: Sorting the data by hand was a slow and laborious process.
meanings.exampleTr: Verileri elle ayıklamak yavaş ve zahmetli bir işti.

meanings.en: in a way that takes a lot of time and effort
meanings.exampleEn: He laboriously copied out the whole document by hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüm belgeyi elle, büyük bir çabayla kopyaladı.

meanings.en: the supply of people available for work and the number of jobs available for them
meanings.exampleEn: Young graduates are entering a very competitive labour market.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç mezunlar oldukça rekabetçi bir iş gücü piyasasına giriyor.

meanings.en: very bad or disappointing; deserving to be regretted
meanings.exampleEn: The team's performance this season has been lamentable.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımın bu sezonki performansı içler acısıydı.

meanings.en: the expression of great sorrow or grief
meanings.exampleEn: The room was filled with the lamentations of the mourners.
meanings.exampleTr: Oda, yas tutanların ağıtlarıyla doldu.

meanings.en: a long, narrow piece of ground on which aircraft can land and take off
meanings.exampleEn: The small plane touched down on a rough landing strip in the jungle.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük uçak, ormandaki engebeli bir iniş pistine indi.

meanings.en: surrounded by land, with no coastline or access to the sea
meanings.exampleEn: Switzerland is a landlocked country in the heart of Europe.
meanings.exampleTr: İsviçre, Avrupa'nın kalbinde denize kıyısı olmayan bir ülkedir.

meanings.en: towards the land rather than the sea
meanings.exampleEn: The wind was blowing landward, pushing the boat towards the shore.
meanings.exampleTr: Rüzgar karaya doğru esiyor, tekneyi kıyıya itiyordu.

meanings.en: a short failure in behaviour, memory or concentration
meanings.exampleEn: A momentary lapse of concentration caused the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlık bir dikkat dağınıklığı kazaya yol açtı.

meanings.tr: (zaman) geçme, aradan geçen süre; (hakkın) sona ermesi
meanings.en: a period of time passing, or the ending of something such as a right or contract
meanings.exampleEn: After a lapse of several years, they met again.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç yılın geçmesinin ardından yeniden karşılaştılar.

meanings.en: involving a large number of people or things, or happening over a large area
meanings.exampleEn: The government launched a large-scale investigation into the fraud.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet, dolandırıcılıkla ilgili büyük çaplı bir soruşturma başlattı.

meanings.en: a girl or young woman (chiefly in northern England and Scotland)
meanings.exampleEn: She's a bonny lass from a small village in Yorkshire.
meanings.exampleTr: O, Yorkshire'daki küçük bir köyden güzel bir genç kız.

meanings.en: the last in a series of unpleasant events that makes a situation unbearable
meanings.exampleEn: When he came home late again, it was the last straw and she left him.
meanings.exampleTr: Yine eve geç gelince bu bardağı taşıran son damla oldu ve kadın onu terk etti.

meanings.tr: son çare olarak yapılan, ümitsizce son bir çaba olan
meanings.en: describing a final, desperate attempt to achieve something before it is too late
meanings.exampleEn: Diplomats made a last-ditch effort to prevent the war.
meanings.exampleTr: Diplomatlar savaşı önlemek için son bir umutsuz çaba gösterdi.

meanings.tr: ileriki yıllar, yaşamın son dönemleri, yaşlılık
meanings.en: the later part of someone's life or a period; old age
meanings.exampleEn: In his later years, he devoted himself to painting.
meanings.exampleTr: İleriki yıllarında kendini resme adadı.

meanings.en: the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees
meanings.exampleEn: The island lies at a latitude of about forty degrees north.
meanings.exampleTr: Ada yaklaşık kırk derece kuzey enleminde yer alır.

meanings.en: freedom to act or think in the way you choose
meanings.exampleEn: Teachers are given considerable latitude in how they run their classes.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlere sınıflarını nasıl yönetecekleri konusunda hayli geniş bir serbestlik tanınır.

meanings.en: deserving praise, even if not completely successful
meanings.exampleEn: Her efforts to help the homeless are laudable.
meanings.exampleTr: Evsizlere yardım etme çabaları övgüye değer.

meanings.en: the quality of being allowed by law or according to the law
meanings.exampleEn: The court examined the lawfulness of the government's decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, hükümetin kararının yasallığını inceledi.

meanings.en: a situation in which laws are not obeyed and there is no order
meanings.exampleEn: The collapse of the government led to widespread lawlessness.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümetin çöküşü, yaygın bir kanunsuzluğa yol açtı.

meanings.tr: uzman olmayan kişi, sıradan insan; meslekten olmayan kimse
meanings.en: a person who does not have specialized or professional knowledge of a subject
meanings.exampleEn: The report explains the science in terms a layman can understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, bilimi sıradan bir insanın anlayabileceği terimlerle açıklıyor.

meanings.en: the gradual escape of a liquid, gas or information through a hole or crack
meanings.exampleEn: A leakage of gas from the pipe caused the explosion.
meanings.exampleTr: Borudan gaz sızması patlamaya neden oldu.

meanings.en: allowing liquid or gas to get in or out through a hole or crack
meanings.exampleEn: We had to replace the leaky roof before winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıştan önce akıtan çatıyı değiştirmek zorunda kaldık.

meanings.en: the quality of being thin and without much fat
meanings.exampleEn: The leanness of the meat makes it a healthy choice.
meanings.exampleTr: Etin yağsızlığı onu sağlıklı bir tercih yapıyor.
